title: Driving Comfort and Overall Experience
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe strong satisfaction with driving comfort, quietness, and the overall vehicle experience, while a few complaints mention awkward doors and a complicated digital interface.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the driving experience, cabin quietness, seating comfort, and overall enjoyment of being in the vehicle.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention a complicated digital interface and doors that open slowly and feel awkward.
